blends.name: Epic Fighter + Platinum Coin = Legendary Famous
blends.desc:
**RomanPunks WAX FIGHTER Blending System**

Combine RomanPunk Trading Cards with [Silver, Gold & Plantinum Blending Coins](https://neftyblocks.com/c/romanpunksio) to upgrade your card to a rarer one. Blend results are drawn from pre-minted pools and include the following recipes:

*Common FIghter + Silver Coin = Rare Fighter
Common Fighter + Gold Coin = Epic FIghter
Rare Fighter + Silver Coin = Epic Fighter
Epic Fighter + Platinum Coin = Legendary Famous*

Cards can be earned by engaging in the Catacombs RPG on [RomanPunks Discord](http://discord.gg/romanpunks) or purchased on the secondary market on [AtomicHub](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/collection/romanpunksio).

Silver, Gold and Platinum Blending coins can be purchased on [NeftyBlocks](https://neftyblocks.com/c/romanpunksio) or earned on the [RomanPunks Discord](https://discord.gg/romanpunks) by completing tasks for 'Denarii' token and redeeming them in the Discord 'store'.

blends.name: Fighter Pack Series II
blends.desc:
# **Blend your Fighter Pack Series II voucher into a Fighter Pack Series II!**

### RomanPunks is a pixel art based, retrofuturistic, cyberpunk derivative world-building project that is inspired by fine art, history and the cryptopunk movement.

*It’s AD 410, the Goths are sacking the city of Rome. A rift in the fabric of space-time occurs at the Temple of Jupiter Capitolinus. Suddenly multiple dimensions collide and coalesce. Time travelers & space farers exist alongside terrestrials who had previously lived thousands of years apart. The world is now a fractured patchwork of time and space with Rome at the center of it all. The world is now RomanPunk.*

Introducing the Fighter Pack Series II

#### 3 NFTs included in the pack

Includes 'common', 'rare', and 'epic' NFTs that are part of the ‘fighter’ schema, which includes cards of the following types: ‘centurion’, ‘gladiator’, & ‘soldier’. These cards can be used for the ‘Live Gladiatorial Games’ contests streamed on [Twitch](https://twitch.tv/romanpunks).

Also includes 'legendary' and 'mythical' NFTs that are part of the 'famous' schema, which includes a range of rarer NFTs that will have higher value for future blending and staking utility.

Read our [Medium page](https://romanpunks.medium.com) for more info on the pack drop and associated contests and challenges. 

Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/romanpunks) to engage with the community and earn additional NFTs through questing and giveaways.

Check out our [website](https://romanpunks.io) to learn all about the history and future of RomanPunks.
